moments.title: Community Shield returns to Cardiff
moments.blurb: The 2026 FA Community Shield, featuring Premier League champions Arsenal and FA Cup winners Manchester City, will be held at Principality Stadium in Cardiff on Sunday, August 16, with a 3 PM BST kick-off.

angles.name: National Hype
angles.copy: Arsenal vs Man City for the Community Shield! The traditional season curtain-raiser is almost here. Who lifts the first silverware of the 26/27 season?

angles.name: Cardiff Host
angles.copy: Cardiff, get ready! The Principality Stadium hosts the FA Community Shield this Sunday as Arsenal take on Manchester City. Big game coming to the Welsh capital!

angles.name: Team Focus
angles.copy: Man City vs Arsenal – a rivalry that just keeps giving! This Sunday, they clash again for the Community Shield. Will City start strong or will Arsenal get early bragging rights?

moments.title: EFL Season Kicks Off: Carabao Cup First Round
moments.blurb: The 2026-27 English Football League season officially begins this weekend with the Carabao Cup First Round, running from August 7-9, with the Championship, League One, and League Two campaigns starting the following weekend.

angles.name: Cup Kick-off
angles.copy: Football is BACK! The Carabao Cup First Round kicks off this weekend, marking the official start of the 26/27 EFL season. Who are you backing for an early cup run?

angles.name: Welsh Derby
angles.copy: Massive Welsh derby in the Carabao Cup! Cardiff City host Wrexham this weekend. Get ready for some fierce local rivalry!

angles.name: EFL Leagues Return
angles.copy: Beyond the cup, the Championship, League One, and League Two seasons are just days away, starting August 14-16. Get ready for the return of league action!

moments.title: The Good Ship Murder sets sail on BritBox
moments.blurb: The new crime drama series 'The Good Ship Murder', starring Shayne Ward and Catherine Tyldesley, premieres on BritBox on Monday, August 10, following a former detective turned cabaret singer solving crimes on a luxury cruise.

angles.name: New Crime Drama
angles.copy: Ready for your next TV obsession? 'The Good Ship Murder' sets sail on BritBox this Monday, August 10. Glamour, mystery and Shayne Ward – what more could you want?

angles.name: Cruise Ship Whodunit
angles.copy: A cabaret singer solving murders on a luxury cruise? Sign us up! Don't miss the new BritBox series 'The Good Ship Murder' dropping on Monday.

moments.title: Roots Picnic makes UK debut in London
moments.blurb: The iconic Roots Picnic festival makes its highly anticipated international debut at Crystal Palace Bowl, London, this weekend, August 8-9, bringing a blend of hip hop, music, culture, and community.

angles.name: London Hip Hop
angles.copy: Big weekend for music in London! The legendary Roots Picnic arrives at Crystal Palace Bowl this Saturday & Sunday. Who's heading to the UK debut?

angles.name: Festival Vibes
angles.copy: From Philly to London, Roots Picnic brings its unique hip hop and culture festival to the Crystal Palace Bowl this weekend. Get ready for some serious vibes!
